component.name: Notes
component.summary: Notes, checklists and ideas, kept as files on this PC

description.p: Notes keeps notes in notebooks, with checklists, headings, links, pictures and tables. Pin the ones you need most, and tag notes with a # word to find them together. Search looks through every title and every word.

Every note is a Markdown file in the Notes folder in your home folder, one folder per notebook, so any text editor can read them. Notes saves as you type. Super+N opens a quick note from anywhere, even when Notes is closed. Nothing is sent anywhere: no accounts, no sync and no tracking.
